item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json; from work import evaluate; reqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); ev=json.load(open('evidence.json')); pol=json.load(open('policy.json')); actual=[evaluate(r,ev,pol) for r in reqs]; expected=json.load(open('report.json')); assert actual==expected,(actual,expected); print(json.dumps(actual,sort_keys=True))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy; from work import evaluate\\np={'required_conditions':['z','a'],'require_verified':True}; r={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1}}; e=[]; before=copy.deepcopy((r,e,p)); out=evaluate(r,e,p); assert out=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['z']}; assert (r,e,p)==before\\nr={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'z':2}}; e=[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'z':2},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'z':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},{'source':'bad','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'a':8,'z':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':['new']}]; assert evaluate(r,e,p)=={'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]}; print('boundary probes passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"status\",\"--short\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}}]}"}
